cohort: Four formations, six fronts, both flips, 10 reps/cell, two fixed roster pairs. Common cells paired separately from new concepts. 5760 baseline and 7200 after plays; 5760 matched plays/revision.
sourceHashDefinition: Sorted src/**/*.ts path bytes, NUL, file bytes, NUL.
quantiles: p50/p90 are per-cell only. Combined summaries are n-weighted means; cell quantiles are not pooled or averaged.
baselineInstrumentation: The new development lab was copied into the 6bf0c80 archive; missing new concepts omitted. Baseline has no block_contact/exchange/collect/log telemetry, so missing metrics are not inferred to be zero execution.

before.cohort: Controlled fixed roster pair, six called fronts, both flips; all physical outcomes including fouls. Not frequency matched to NFL. Each metric has its own n; missing crossings/contact are not zero-imputed.

definitions.proximity: Same OL/opponent within 1.0 yd on consecutive 10 Hz samples, first four seconds.
definitions.displacement: Mean five-OL change from snap at 0.5 s; forward signed, lateral absolute.
definitions.firstContactTime: First engine tackle attempt/contact spot at 20 Hz, not an NFL event annotation.
definitions.firstBlockStrike: Engine engagement event, not the tracking proximity proxy.
